name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default. This guarantees keyboard users can bypass repetitive navigation in one click, solving the most common keyboard accessibility failure. The trade-off is screen space, but it’s negligible compared to the usability gain—especially on mobile where touch targets are already crowded.

name: Reader
text: Large skip links push primary content below the fold on short pages, hurting users who rely on context. A hidden skip link with keyboard-only focus solves the space issue without the risk. Test both with real keyboard users—success is when they reach the main content faster without confusion.
